CREATE TABLE #tbl
WITH
( DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN
)
AS
SELECT 
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) AS SQ,
CONCAT('INSERT INTO [EDS].[LOAD_DATES]
( 
	[DESCRIPTION],
	[SCHEMA_NAME],
	[TABLE_NAME],
	[SOURCE_CODE],
	[INSERT_DATE],
	[INSERT_TIME],
	[MIN_LOAD_DATE],
	[MAX_LOAD_DATE]
)

SELECT 
	''',DESCRIPTION,''' DESCRIPTION,
	''',SCHEMA_NAME,''' SCHEMA_NAME,
	''',TABLE_NAME,''' TABLE_NAME,
	''',SOURCE_CODE,''' SOURCE_CODE,	
	CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE ''Singapore Standard Time'' AS date) INSERT_DATE,
	CONCAT(FORMAT(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE ''Singapore Standard Time'',''hh''),'':'',''00'') INSERT_TIME,
    MIN(',CASE WHEN TABLE_NAME LIKE '%ACCOUNT_HOLDER%' THEN 'AAS_AS_OF_DATE' WHEN TABLE_NAME LIKE '%FACT%' THEN 'AS_OF_DATE' ELSE 'CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE)' END,'),
    MAX(',CASE WHEN TABLE_NAME LIKE '%ACCOUNT_HOLDER%' THEN 'AAS_AS_OF_DATE' WHEN TABLE_NAME LIKE '%FACT%' THEN 'AS_OF_DATE' ELSE 'CAST(LEFT(RIGHT(FILE_NAME , 12), 8) AS DATE)' END,')
    FROM ',SCHEMA_NAME,'.',TABLE_NAME) AS sql_code
FROM 
	OM.OM_TASKS 
WHERE 
	DATA_LAYER IN ('EDS','BUSC') AND TABLE_NAME NOT IN ('AREA_DIM','REGION_DIM');


DECLARE @nbr_statements INT = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM #tbl)
,       @i INT = 1
;

WHILE   @i <= @nbr_statements
BEGIN
    DECLARE @sql_code NVARCHAR(4000) = (SELECT sql_code FROM #tbl WHERE SQ = @i);
    EXEC    sp_executesql @sql_code;
    SET     @i +=1;
END

DROP TABLE #tbl;
